knownProblems: The combat track (Boarding Party) is a 44 s take and loops audibly; the longer second take is in the Suno workspace.

A bee-line run finishes in ~15 minutes at the new pace; exploring branches, yards and nodes stretches it to 25+.
Event cards have no illustrations yet; expedition foes are silhouettes (procedural).
